sections.heading: iPad mini and the Environment
sections.source_text:
iPad mini is designed to reduce environmental impact:
13
See the iPad mini Product En­viron­men­tal Report (PDF)
Progress towards Apple 2030
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritising the use of recycled and renewable content and low‑carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment
Materials
iPad mini is made with 35% recycled content,
13
including:
100% recycled aluminium in the enclosure
100% recycled cobalt in the battery
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
95% recycled lithium in the battery
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
80% recycled steel in multiple components including the logo and speaker components
Energy
ENERGY STAR® certified
14
Packaging
100% fibre-based packaging
15
Waste
No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Programme
Smarter chemistry
16
All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our
Regulated Substances Specification (PDF)
, which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest
En­viron­men­tal Progress Report (PDF)
to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
